snippet.title: Nine Rounds Rapid - Official Early Access Release Window Trailer | The MIX Fall Game Showcase 2025
snippet.description:
Check out the Nine Rounds Rapid early access release window trailer for this upcoming top-down roguelite shooter game to see action-packed gameplay. Nine Rounds Rapid will be available on PC, PlayStation, Xbox, and Nintendo Switch, and will launch into Early Access in June 2026.


Two fugitives. On the run. On the hunt. Blast your way through a possessed, fragmenting space station to seize your fortune, freedom, and uncover the ugly truth. Stack abilities, upgrade your arsenal, and prove yourself in Nine Rounds Rapid.
